# Conformance ledger

<!-- Generated by scripts/conformance.py from docs/conformance.toml. Edit that file. -->

Every check an Agave v4.4.1 validator applies between a data shred
arriving and a transaction counting as executed in a finalized block, and
what the verifier does about each. The verifier does far less work than a
validator; this is the argument that it does enough.

128 checks: 49 enforced, 59 implied,
8 documented, 2 planned, 10 not about block content.

- **Enforced**: the verifier applies the same rule or a stricter one. The
  named test shows it.
- **Implied**: the verifier does not check it. A block that fails it is
  never finalized, for the reason the named premise gives.
- **Documented**: nothing a proof can settle. The documentation says what
  a successful check does and does not mean.
- **Planned**: should be enforced and is not yet.

## Premises

An implied row is only as good as the premise it cites. Each premise is
meant to be shown by cases in the differential oracle
(`tools/agave-fixtures`), which runs Agave's own code.

- **`votes-follow-replay`** (27 rows). Validators vote for a block only after replaying it without error, and at most 20% of stake is Byzantine. So a block that dies in replay, or is never replayed, is never finalized.
  This is the trust assumption, not something the oracle can show. The oracle shows the other half: that Agave marks the slot dead.
  Oracle cases: none yet.
- **`dropped-shreds-never-complete`** (13 rows). A shred that the fetch filter or sanitize drops is never inserted, whether it arrived by turbine, by repair, or out of erasure recovery. A block that needs it never becomes full.
  Oracle cases: none yet.
- **`replay-from-zero`** (0 rows). With no UpdateParent, replay reads every shred from index 0.
  Oracle cases: none yet.
- **`component-parse-kills`** (4 rows). If any one component fails to parse, the slot dies.
  Oracle cases: none yet.
- **`every-batch-executed`** (4 rows). Every entry batch is executed. Nothing may follow the boundary tick.
  Oracle cases: none yet.
- **`every-transaction-commits-or-kills`** (11 rows). Every transaction in an executed batch is committed or kills the block. None is silently skipped.
  Committed has three shapes; see rows 105 to 107.
  Oracle cases: none yet.

| 108 | Cost limits | runtime/src/transaction_execution.rs:88-99, 152-168 (WouldExceed*) | dead | Implied: `every-transaction-commits-or-kills`. No transaction is dropped for cost in replay. |

## Bytes that may differ

What two honest validators can hold differently for the same block id.

| # | Check | Agave | If it fails | Verifier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 121 | Leader signature (bytes 0..64) is outside the leaf | ledger/src/shred/merkle.rs:191-203 |  | Enforced: `every_agave_transaction_is_provable_and_parses_identically`. Not in a proof at all. |
| 122 | Retransmitter signature is re-signed on every hop | turbine/src/sigverify_shreds.rs:357 |  | Enforced: `resigned_shreds_verify_too` |
| 123 | The in-shred Merkle proof is outside the leaf | ledger/src/shred/merkle.rs:295-310 |  | Enforced: `agave_shreds_reject_tampering`. Recomputed, never trusted. |
| 124 | Packet bytes after the shred (repair nonce) | ledger/src/shred/wire.rs:38-62 |  | Enforced: `a_short_payload_is_not_a_shred_and_trailing_bytes_are_ignored` |
| 125 | Body bytes past `size` are in the leaf and are not data |  |  | Enforced: `data_is_zero_extended_to_size` |
| 126 | Reference tick bits and chained root are in the leaf and never validated |  |  | Enforced: `position_is_part_of_the_leaf` |
| 127 | Bytes 20..32 of each FEC root and of the parent leaf do not enter the block id | ledger/src/shred/merkle_tree.rs |  | Documented. The 20-byte truncation. See DESIGN.md, Merkle truncation. |
| 128 | Original and alternate copies of a slot | ledger/src/blockstore.rs:411-415 |  | Enforced: `shreds_of_one_block_do_not_open_another`. Different block ids. |
